description: OCHRE, published by National Laboratory of the Rockies, models residential end-use loads, flexible devices and distributed energy resources with thermal and electrical interactions. Coverage: Users configure a dwelling or individual equipment and choose simulation time step and duration. The repository does not impose a universal geographic coverage. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is BSD-3-Clause. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The documented Python requirement is at least 3.9 and below 3.13. Numerical behaviour and building-to-grid coupling were not executed in this review. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
